MCD.rationale: McDonald's presents a mixed but mildly attractive picture. The franchise-heavy model (~95% franchised) generates strong operating margins (~46%) and robust cash flow, with Q1 2026 showing 9% YoY revenue growth and 6.9% EPS growth. However, the balance sheet carries negative equity (-$1.29B), and QoQ trends show sequential deceleration (revenue -7.9%, EPS -12.6%). The stock has declined ~10% over the past quarter to $278.61, trading near 52-week lows, which may reflect some valuation reset. Gross margin compression to 56% (8-quarter low) and competitive pressures from grocery stores in a 'hyper-value environment' are headwinds. The company's defensive characteristics (low beta 0.23, 2.77% dividend yield, 50 consecutive years of dividend increases) provide downside support. No clear near-term fundamental catalyst is evident beyond ongoing value strategy execution and unit expansion plans targeting 50,000 restaurants by 2027.
